title: PROSE Template Mini-Cloud
description: Public-safe registry for reusable PROSE document templates. The canonical repository manifest remains the primary source, while extension packs can be added without rewriting the core catalog.

extensions.title: Daily Checklist
extensions.description: A clean daily planning checklist with top priorities, task tracking, appointments, follow-up, notes, and an end-of-day review.

futurePacks.purpose: Subject, grade-level, academic, research, publishing, and professional template packs may be registered here without exposing private runtime architecture.
